headline: House Intel chair-elect threatens SpaceX funding over Starshield
pages: Rep. Jim Himes of Connecticut, expected to chair the House Intelligence Committee in January, has threatened to withhold support for funding government-owned systems from SpaceX. In a Friday letter to Elon Musk, he said a potentially unilateral change by SpaceX to a US government contract, plus its lack of response to congressional oversight, calls every government contract with the company into question. CNN first reported the letter and said Himes sent a similar classified message to Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton. The dispute centers on Starshield, a militarized version of Starlink that the US bought and extended to Ukraine.

In recent weeks, service interruptions have cut connectivity to Ukrainian defense drones. On Oct. 19, President Zelensky said the equipment stops working at certain speeds, slowing logistics and limiting some drones. Why it matters: it puts SpaceX's broader military business at risk. Source: Ars Technica.
